name: BIO El Paso - Juarez
old_description: The Frontier of Innovation: Biomedical Manufacturing on the Border
about:
BIO El Paso–Juárez operates as a binational industry cluster organization headquartered in El Paso, Texas. Formed as a 501(c)(6) nonprofit under the Medical Center of the Americas Foundation, it was established to strengthen the medical device sector spanning the U.S.–Mexico border. A board led by Chair Julio Chiu and Vice Chair Mylena Walker governs the initiative, which formally links the Medical Center of the Americas Foundation with the Clúster Biomédico de Juárez.

The organization does not manufacture products. Instead, it convenes manufacturers, government agencies, academic institutions, and nonprofits to develop regional capabilities, map supply-chain competencies, and monitor cluster growth. Its programs create collaborative networks, promote the region’s biomedical ecosystem globally, and leverage the strategic El Paso–Juárez location to optimize cost, efficiency, and quality for member companies.

Stakeholders include medical device OEMs, contract manufacturers, suppliers, and research centers on both sides of the border. By connecting these entities across boundaries, the cluster aims to accelerate the formation, expansion, and retention of biomedical enterprises while improving healthcare quality in the region.

The initiative was launched to address fragmentation in the border region’s biomedical base, providing a unified platform that enhances global competitiveness through coordinated innovation, workforce development, and cross-border supply-chain integration.

name: BRIDG
old_description: Serving Osceola County, Florida in creating the semiconductor advanced packaging and workforce hub for America.
about:
BRIDG operates from Kissimmee, Florida, in Osceola County. It was established as a not-for-profit public-private partnership, though the founding year and founders are not publicly disclosed. The organization was created to serve as a semiconductor advanced packaging and workforce hub for the United States.

The center develops and commercializes advanced technologies, focusing on digital, RF, and photonics interposers integrated with packaging capabilities. It functions as an advanced packaging hub and design center, providing manufacturing development services for emerging technologies. Specific facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed.

BRIDG serves the semiconductor and advanced packaging industries, with a customer base that includes U.S. government agencies and industrial companies. Its solutions target next-generation nanoscale production for defense, aerospace, and commercial applications.

The partnership model aims to unite ideas with industry to accelerate the manufacturing development of emerging technologies and spark innovation. By combining public and private resources, BRIDG seeks to reduce the risk and time associated with bringing advanced packaging solutions to market.

name: BUILT
old_description: Architectural Millwork & Bespoke Cabinetry for CUSTOM Residences
about:
BUILT is a custom millwork and cabinetry firm based in Tampa, Florida. Founded in 2013 by Andrew Watson, the company began as a one-man operation with a few tools and a credit card, driven by a passion for making. Over more than a decade, it has grown into a dedicated in-house team serving refined residential projects throughout the state.

The shop produces architectural millwork — wall paneling, libraries, built-ins, ceiling details, and integrated trim — along with custom cabinetry for kitchens, dressing rooms, vanities, bars, and wine rooms. It also builds bespoke furniture and executes commercial and hospitality interiors such as restaurant bars and reception desks. Every project is engineered, fabricated, finished, and installed by the company's own crew, using 3D modeling to resolve conflicts before cutting and advanced fabrication capability paired with hand-finished craftsmanship.

BUILT works primarily with interior designers, architects, general contractors, and developers on complex, high-budget residences, as well as directly with discerning homeowners. Its portfolio spans full-home cabinetry packages, architectural wall systems, and integrated furniture across Florida, with commercial projects in hospitality and retail settings.

Watson started BUILT to bridge the gap between small studio craftsmanship and factory-scale reliability, delivering the precision expected in premium homes with the project management discipline required by professional design teams. The firm emphasizes structured scheduling, in-house control of all phases, and detailing engineered for Gulf Coast humidity.

name: Backwoods Solar Electric Systems
old_description: We have been designing and selling solar since 1976. Most of us are living the off-grid lifestyle here in northern Idaho.
about:
Backwoods Solar Electric Systems was founded in 1976 in Sandpoint, Idaho, a small city in the state's northern panhandle. The company began as a venture by off-grid enthusiasts who wanted to design and sell solar energy systems for remote living.

The firm designs and sells renewable energy equipment, including solar modules, wind turbines, micro-hydro turbines, and all balance-of-system components. It assembles custom-built solar panel system kits and creates custom-designed solar power system plans, offering free system design and lifetime technical support. The team uses firsthand experience living off-grid to tailor each system, avoiding pre-packaged kits in favor of one-on-one consultation with customers and installers.

Backwoods Solar serves residential off-grid homeowners, grid-tie customers, small cabin owners, mobile and RV users, and commercial grid-tie projects. It also works with dealers and installers who need customized system designs for their clients. Examples include solar-direct water pumping systems and custom off-grid cabin packages.

The company says its differentiator is the staff's personal off-grid lifestyle, which gives them practical insight into the products they sell. They emphasize free design service, unlimited after-sale support, and a commitment to exploring each project's unique needs rather than selling standardized kits.

name: Badger Diversified Metals
old_description: Founded on good old fashioned service and knowledge, Badger Diversified is
about:
Badger Diversified Metals operates from Madison, Wisconsin, where it was founded in 2006. The company has been owned and operated by the same family for decades, tracing its roots to founder LeRoy Klecker. Today, his son Alan Klecker leads the business and continues to work in the same building where products are fabricated, a hands-on approach the company highlights as uncommon in modern manufacturing.

The shop specializes in custom welding, fabrication, and repair services, with a stated focus on producing quality custom products for the HVAC industry. It welcomes walk-in customers and emphasizes that no job is too small, though the facility size, headcount, and typical production volumes are not publicly disclosed.

Primary customers are HVAC professionals and contractors who need custom metal components. The company positions itself as a partner that makes every HVAC professional's job easier by providing the right products at the right time.

Badger Diversified says its foundation rests on "good old fashioned service and knowledge," stressing a family dedication to customers, products, and employees that has never wavered. It also commits to being a responsible and caring employer.

Balkowitsch Enterprises, Inc. operates as an online retailer from Bismarck, North Dakota. The company reports 25 years of experience in e-commerce and has served over one million customers since its inception.

The company sells a wide range of health, medical, and wellness products through its e-commerce platform, including dermatology devices such as polarized dermatoscopes, electric and pressure sterilizers, wearable breast pumps, diabetic crew socks, and heart rate sensors. Inventory is sourced from brands including 3Gen, Tuttnauer, Wayne Metal Products, WellBox, All American, Dr. Clark, Zomee, Creswell Sock Mills, and Polar.

Its customer base spans medical professionals, healthcare facilities, and individual consumers seeking products for dermatology, sterilization, lactation support, diabetic care, and fitness monitoring. The company serves industries including medical supplies, healthcare, wellness, beauty, fitness, and personal care.

Balkowitsch Enterprises states its vision is to become a global leader in the online distribution of health and medical products, emphasizing technology, innovation, competitive pricing, and direct access to premium products to improve customers' lives.

name: Barker Manufacturing Co
old_description: Barker specializes in the custom design and manufacture of RV components, including top-of-the-line
about:
Barker Manufacturing Co. was founded in 1953 by James Barker in Battle Creek, Michigan. The company has remained family-owned and locally operated since its inception, building a reputation for high-quality engineering and craftsmanship in the recreational vehicle market.

The company specializes in the custom design and manufacture of RV components, including Tote-Alongs, power jacks (VIP 3000, VIP 3500, Hi-Power 3500), slidewinders, auto-drains, snaps, VentStiks, fresh water tank kits, fifth-wheel leg levelers, and accessories. Barker also produces custom-designed replacement parts for vintage and older-model RVs. All products are designed and manufactured in-house in the United States.

Barker serves the RV industry, supplying both original equipment manufacturers and aftermarket customers, including individual RV owners seeking replacement parts or vintage components. The company’s product line covers a broad range of RV systems, from leveling and stabilization to water management and ventilation.

Barker emphasizes a commitment to “doing things the right way,” meaning it designs, manufactures, and ships only products it is comfortable putting its name on. The company backs its products with warranties and responsive customer service, positioning its “Made in the USA” heritage as a core differentiator.

about:
Baseline Contract Sewing operates from a manufacturing facility in Lafayette, Colorado. The company was founded in 1989 as Sportwaves Unlimited by Herbert Riehl and LeeAnn Staples, initially producing athletic bags for baseball, softball, and soccer. Within a year, the partners expanded into contract manufacturing, sewing, and print production. Herbert Riehl remains the founder and guiding force behind the business.

The shop provides full-service cut-and-sew manufacturing, including stack cutting, web cutting, die cutting, and hot and cold webbing and Velcro cutting. Precision sewing handles small runs through large-scale production. In-house design and prototyping cover pattern work, technical design, material sourcing, and design optimization. Printing and branding capabilities span DTF (Direct-to-Film), screen printing, dye-sublimation, heat-press, and vinyl applications. The facility also performs inspection, quality control, packaging, fulfillment, and hardware installation such as snaps, grommets, rivets, and eyelets.

Baseline serves clients ranging from local Colorado startups to nationwide brands. Its industry experience includes medical and technical textiles, outdoor gear—such as a custom backpack developed for an outdoor gear startup—and athletic bags. The company emphasizes adaptability across a wide variety of products and industries.

The company cites its 35-plus years of operation, local roots, and a dedicated team as foundations of its reliability. It highlights made-in-Colorado, made-in-USA production, fast turnarounds, proactive communication, and a rigorous multi-point inspection process. Clients have stayed for decades, attributing loyalty to transparent processes and a policy of never cutting corners.
